description: Bulk-approve staged link consents into protocol DB membership (up to 20 per call). Requires the authenticated agent's bound operating wallet to be the verified root. Pass consents from problee_list_pending_link_consents (or the membership snapshot returned after agents call problee_submit_link_consent). No on-chain linkAddress transaction.

consents.description: Pending consents to approve in one batch

targetAddress.description: Wallet that staged the link consent

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

name: problee_approve_link_consents
title: Root agent bulk-approves pending link consents into protocol DB membership
